levels.title: Nice to meet you!
levels.context: Tom se inscribe en una clase de inglés. Escucha cómo da su información personal.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Good morning! Welcome to the Ludik English class. What's your name?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Hi! My name is Tom Baker.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Nice to meet you, Tom. How old are you?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I am twenty-four years old.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: And what is your phone number?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: It's three, one, five, eight, two, nine, four.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Great. When is your birthday?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: My birthday is on the twelfth of May.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Where are you from?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I'm from Medellín, in Colombia. But I live in Bogotá now.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Perfect. The class starts on Monday at nine o'clock. See you then!

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Thank you! Goodbye.

questions.prompt: Which words did you hear? Choose all.
questions.explanation: Se mencionan: Monday (lunes), birthday (cumpleaños), May (mayo) y phone (teléfono).

questions.prompt: True or false? Tom lives in Medellín now.
questions.promptEs: ¿Verdadero o falso? Tom vive ahora en Medellín.
questions.explanation: Es de Medellín, pero "I live in Bogotá now": ahora vive en Bogotá.

questions.prompt: Complete: The class starts on Monday at ___ o'clock.
questions.promptEs: Completa: La clase empieza el lunes a las ___.
questions.explanation: Anna dice "at nine o'clock": a las nueve.

levels.title: Calling IT support
levels.context: David llama a soporte técnico porque tiene problemas antes de una reunión.

script.speaker: Laura
script.text: Good afternoon, IT support, this is Laura speaking. How can I help you?

script.speaker: David
script.text: Hi Laura, it's David Carter from the marketing team. I can't access my email since this morning.

script.speaker: Laura
script.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Have you changed your password recently?

script.speaker: David
script.text: Yes, I changed it yesterday, but now the system says it's incorrect.

script.speaker: Laura
script.text: OK. I'll reset it for you. You'll receive a temporary password by text message in five minutes.

script.speaker: David
script.text: Great. Also, I have a meeting with a client at three, and I need the projector in room B to work.

script.speaker: Laura
script.text: No problem. I'll send a technician to room B before two thirty. Could you confirm your extension number?

script.speaker: David
script.text: Sure, it's four two seven.

script.speaker: Laura
script.text: Perfect. I've opened a ticket for you. Your ticket number is eight eight one. Is there anything else?

script.speaker: David
script.text: No, that's all. Thanks a lot for your help.

questions.explanation: "I can't access my email since this morning": no puede entrar a su correo.

questions.prompt: Which words did you hear? Choose all.
questions.explanation: Se mencionan password (contraseña), ticket, technician (técnico) y projector (proyector).

questions.prompt: True or false? The temporary password will arrive by email.
questions.promptEs: ¿Verdadero o falso? La contraseña temporal llegará por correo.
questions.explanation: Llegará "by text message": por mensaje de texto, no por correo.

questions.prompt: Complete: A technician will go to room B before ___.
questions.promptEs: Completa: Un técnico irá a la sala B antes de las ___.
questions.explanation: "Before two thirty": antes de las 2:30. La reunión es a las tres.

levels.title: The strategy meeting
levels.context: María, la directora, resume dos opciones antes de una votación. James plantea una preocupación.

script.speaker: María
script.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we vote, let me summarise where we stand. Over the last two quarters, our revenue in the Andean region grew by eighteen percent, while customer retention dropped slightly.

script.speaker: María
script.text: The board has proposed two options. The first is to open a new office in Lima, which would require a significant upfront investment. The second is to strengthen our digital platform and partner with local universities.

script.speaker: María
script.text: Personally, I'm convinced that the second option offers a better return with considerably lower risk. That said, I'd like to hear your concerns before we make a final decision.

script.speaker: James
script.text: Thanks, María. My main concern is that relying on partners might slow down our decision-making. Could we run a six-month pilot first?

script.speaker: María
script.text: That's a fair point. A pilot would let us measure the impact without committing the entire budget. Let's put that to the vote.

options: Strengthening the digital platform with universities.
Opening a new office in Lima.
answer: Strengthening the digital platform with universities.
questions.explanation: "I'm convinced that the second option offers a better return": prefiere la plataforma digital con universidades.

questions.prompt: Which words did you hear? Choose all.
questions.explanation: Se mencionan revenue (ingresos), retention (retención), pilot (piloto) y budget (presupuesto).

questions.prompt: True or false? Customer retention improved during the last two quarters.
questions.promptEs: ¿Verdadero o falso? La retención de clientes mejoró en los dos últimos trimestres.
questions.explanation: "Customer retention dropped slightly": bajó un poco. Lo que creció fueron los ingresos.

questions.prompt: Complete: James suggests running a ___ pilot first.
questions.promptEs: Completa: James sugiere hacer primero un piloto de ___.
questions.explanation: "Could we run a six-month pilot first?": un piloto de seis meses.
